A customer sends a picture and asks: do you have it, how much, can you deliver? You are serving someone in front of you, so you reply an hour later, and they have bought it elsewhere. Or your staff says yes, then finds the shelf empty.

With Relynked: every product in your supermarket or provision store keeps its own count. Remy, the assistant inside Relynked, answers on WhatsApp with what you actually have and what it costs, and takes the order. When something finishes, Remy stops offering it.

  • Update stock by telling Ask Remy what came in, or edit it in the app.
  • You choose the level that counts as low.
  • Every order gets its own number and is confirmed with a clear yes.

What you get: everything your supermarket or provision store runs on, in one place.
